title: Unit Event — Star of Your Own Story — Episode7 Weaving Tales Together

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime have decided to work with other troupes, starting with the long-established Shunmeiza. Given a minor role with just three lines, Tsukasa faces a seemingly impossible task: to convince the director that his character is a real person.

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, uhh... Then, what about...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What if Nakayama's really from outer space and is here to investigate the Earth?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think that's going a little too far...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's becoming harder and harder to come up with good ideas.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
When's Bakuno gonna get here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
He should be arriving soon.
I just received word that he's right by the station... Ah, excellent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Bakuno!
Over here!!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, Tenma...
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Huh? All of Wonderlands×Showtime is here...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Bakuno!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really appreciate your joining us on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
No, um... It's not a problem...!
I was able to come because this park just happened to be where I usually run.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: So, uhh... You said on the phone that you needed my help figuring out how to play your character...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Let me jump right in.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need your help coming up with a story where Nakayama the editor is the main character!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, Tsukasa.
He's not gonna understand if you start with that. You gotta tell him everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: You want to turn a supporting character into a protagonist...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Precisely!
I feel that I must in order to really become my character!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I tried coming up with various stories about Nakayama on my own based on what you told me the other day, but none of them fit quite right...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Then, would you mind showing me what you've come up with?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, here!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Huh...?
All these sheets of binder paper...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: How many stories did you come up with?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: About fifty!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Although, I didn't come up with all of them on my own. Rui and the others helped quite a bit. Unfortunately, I'm not imaginative enough to come up with stories for other people.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Together, we came up with many...
But none of them felt right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why we'd like to hear from you since you're a pro when it comes to this, Bakuno!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm not a pro...
You're giving me too much credit...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, this story is the one we thought was the best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um... This one is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The one where Nakayama thinks he knows a lot about books, but Hino knows even more and works with a famous author, so Nakayama sees him as a rival!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, with this in mind, the way I read the three lines changed greatly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Morning.” “That novelist giving you trouble again?”
“No choice, I suppose.”
Like that!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
That's incredible...!
You sound completely different from how you did during practice!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: If Nakayama sees Hino as his rival, then does that mean he has some sort of inferiority complex? Maybe they joined at the same time, and everyone always compares the two...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, what if something happened between them at work? Like Hino outperforming him...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... That's actually our plot twist for the second act of Nakayama's story!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A novelist he was hoping to work with ends up going to Hino instead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
He feels his losses piling up...!
But then, someone asks whether or not he'd like to become the editor for a girls' manga magazine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because of how much he's struggling at his current workplace, he decides to take the leap and change jobs! Lo and behold, he thrives as an editor for girls' manga!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...!
I really like that...!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: However, because you've come up with such a good ending, I'd like to hear more about the conflict he undergoes before he finds success. For example...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: You could try changing the root of his inferiority complex. What if he was writing his own novel, but was forced to become an editor instead? Maybe a love triangle was also involved...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Raising his age drastically could also make things more interesting. Seeing a younger coworker succeed could wound an older man's pride.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course...!
Even the smallest changes would greatly impact how he behaves towards Hino...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
You're coming up with all these ideas so fast!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Wow...
Your powers of imagination are certainly impressive.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Still, this is only one possibility out of many... Some more ideas may help give you a better understanding of who he is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah... In that case...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What if Nakayama used to be Hino's mentor? And he was the very first junior Hino was asked to look after, and Hino initially doted on him.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes, I like it!
And they could...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe!
They're having so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I sense some good results coming.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hino.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“How was it?
Did you enjoy the girls' manga they put me in charge of editing?”

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: “I never expected you to ask me for my opinion.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“I want to know.
And give it to me straight.”

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: “To be honest, I've never read many things like this before...”

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: “But girls' manga is far more interesting than I initially realized.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And scene!
That was excellent.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I felt that you really had become Nakayama just now, Tsukasa. And your conversation with Hino felt so natural.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-It did?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
You were really amazing, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I actually felt relieved when I saw that Nakayama's hard work had finally paid off.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I did it!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Bakuno!
We created a believable story about Nakayama! All that's left is for me is to master this role by remembering what I just did with every fiber of my being!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You're welcome.
*Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something the matter, Bakuno?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
No, um...
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: It's been so long since I last had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you're happy, Bakuno, then I'm happy!!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Haha. I can't help but feel a little embarrassed when you put it so plainly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe!
He's smiling from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, he is.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Tenma.
All of you from Wonderlands×Showtime...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best until we do this for real!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Nene, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!
